title: Consciousness lives on an inner screen of nested blankets

statements.text: A quantum information version of the principle implies an inner screen hypothesis: conscious experience follows from the nested, holographic structure of the brain's Markov blankets, which also supports overt and covert action.

sources.quote: In particular, we consider the inner screen hypothesis that follows from the quantum information theoretic version of the FEP.
We focus on the holographic structure of the brain, and how this structure supports (overt and covert) action.
